**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

- **§ 12.3** affirmatively disclaims any exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment by Customer, and confirms our freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell, or use any product or service and operate in any field or territory.
- **§ 2.1** confirms no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, so there is no de facto exclusivity.
- **§ 13.4** licence restrictions are limited to reverse engineering, interference, security bypass, and unlawful use — no "build a competing product" clause.
- The only competition-related restraints run **against Vendor** (§ 12.4 no competing analytics service; § 24 no assignment to a Customer competitor), which is favourable to us and not flagged.
